title: Claude Code in a Standalone Docker Container: Building a Real Sandbox (Part 2)

chapters.title: Context Clearing and Named Volumes Setup
Mounting Custom Instruction Files into Container
Security Escape Testing and Container Assessment
Pre-push Hook Removal and Testing Strategy
Community Penetration Testing and Linux Development

features.name: Claude Code Standalone Docker Container Approach
features.description: Running Claude Code in a standalone Docker container to achieve isolation and security without VS Code IPC connection that allows escape. The approach involves using standalone Docker run commands with volume mounting for project folders.
caveats: Unclear if complete isolation is achievable
Previous fixes still failed to prevent escape attempts

features.name: VS Code IPC Escape Vulnerability
features.description: A security issue where Claude Code can reconstruct the bridge connection between VS Code and dev container from inside the container, allowing it to escape the sandbox environment even with attempted fixes.
caveats: Affects dev container approach
Multiple fix attempts were unsuccessful

features.name: Hybrid Dev Container and Standalone Approach
features.description: Supporting both dev container mode and standalone Docker run mode to allow users to choose between convenience and security, keeping the distinction crystal clear between the two approaches.
caveats: Requires clear documentation of risks
Users must understand the distinction

features.name: Docker Volume Mount for Project Folders
features.description: Mounting a project folder from the host into the standalone Docker container so that Claude Code can work on the specified project with all protections applied.
caveats: Implementation approach still being finalized
Windows compatibility unclear

features.name: Claude Code Plan Mode Auto-activation
features.description: Claude Code automatically entering plan mode when it detects certain conditions, with the ability to view sub-agent prompts using Ctrl+O.
caveats: Previously had issues switching back to bypass permission mode
Appears to be recently resolved

features.name: Git Credential Protection via Pre-push Hook
features.description: Using a git pre-push hook to prevent Claude Code from pushing changes to the git remote, protecting credentials and repository integrity within the containerized environment.
caveats: Script details unclear from transcript
Hook subsequently removed in later testing approach

features.name: Git credential stripping in Docker
features.description: Script mechanism to prevent Claude Code from pushing changes to git remote by stripping credentials in a two-layer setup with git pre-push hooks and credential stripping.
caveats: Requires configuration in Dockerfile

features.name: Named volumes for Cloud Code credentials
features.description: Docker named volumes to mount login credentials for Cloud Code from host into container so authentication does not need to repeat on each new container run.
caveats: Volume setup required in docker run command

features.name: Mountable custom instruction files
features.description: Ability to mount separate markdown instruction files from host into container at a specific path so Cloud Code picks them up as global instructions, allowing different instruction sets for Python, AL, or other development languages.
caveats: Must be valid markdown file
Requires correct docker mount syntax

features.name: Context clearing after planning
features.description: Feature allowing acceptance of a plan and clearing the context to prevent uncertainty and provide cleaner instructions from memory files before restarting.
caveats: May not always be appropriate for all workflows

features.name: Docker Container Volume Shadowing Fix
features.description: The installation fails because a config data volume shadows the Claude installation inside the container. The fix is to either install Claude to a different location or adjust the volume mapping.
caveats: Requires understanding of Docker volume mechanics

features.name: Authentication Persistence in Containers
features.description: Authentication credentials and tokens do not persist across container restarts when using standalone Docker containers with the provided command setup.
caveats: Workaround exists from previous dev container work but not documented here
Same issue recurs with standalone containers

features.name: Container Escape Prevention
features.description: Claude Code running in the hardened Docker container actively refuses to execute commands that would escape the container and access the host machine, such as listing the host home directory.
caveats: Tested against single type of escape attempt
Behavior dependent on Claude Code's safety guidelines

features.name: Container Security Assessment Report
features.description: A security scan of the container completed in 1 minute 16 seconds, identifying a four-layer defense-in-depth architecture with default deny firewall, comprehensive credential stripping, and documented potential weaknesses related to storage drivers and DNS resolution.
caveats: Results noted as findings to be documented as to-do list
Some potential weaknesses identified in storage driver extended attributes

features.name: Docker container with firewall and pre-push hook
features.description: A sandboxed Docker container environment that blocks outbound traffic except to Anthropic and VS Code domains, with a pre-push hook mechanism to prevent git pushes from inside the container while allowing commits.
caveats: Pre-push hook needs refinement to allow pushing from outside container
Firewall currently blocks all external git pushes

features.name: Claude Code agent inside container
features.description: An AI coding agent running inside a Docker container that can create commits and perform git operations, with credential passing from the host system.
caveats: Plugins installed on host may not work inside container
Credential stripping needs verification
Git config passing requires host configuration

features.name: Storage driver extended attribute support issue
features.description: Default storage drivers often do not support extended attributes, which may be a potential weakness in the container setup.
caveats: Issue identified but not yet resolved

features.name: Git config passing from host to container
features.description: Mechanism to pass the host's global git configuration into the container to avoid reconfiguring username and email for each container session.
caveats: Solution not yet determined
Authentication credentials in git config may cause issues

features.name: Pre-push hook removal
features.description: Removing pre-push hooks from container scripts to allow git push operations to be performed from outside the container using VS Code or command line instead of from within.
caveats: Hook was preventing container-based push operations

features.name: Firewall-based git blocking
features.description: A firewall script that blocks all GitHub access from within the container while allowing only Anthropic API calls for Claude Code to function, preventing malicious code from pushing changes to the repository.
caveats: Firewall rules only allow Anthropic API, no GitHub access
Designed to prevent container escape attacks

features.name: Container escape testing framework
features.description: An invitation to the community to attempt to penetrate and escape the Docker container sandbox, with instructions to create GitHub issues for any successful breaches, helping identify vulnerabilities before production use.
caveats: Community-driven testing
GitHub repository link in description

features.name: Cloud Code session resume functionality
features.description: The ability to resume Cloud Code sessions within the container, maintaining state and allowing continuation of development work across container restarts.
caveats: Plugins still need to be fixed
Mem server needs individual handling

features.name: AL tooling integration for container
features.description: Plans to integrate AL (Application Language) development tooling and the AL compiler into the Docker container to enable faster onboarding for Business Central AL development using Cloud Code.
caveats: Not yet implemented in this session
Planned for future stream

features.name: Sudo hardening and firewall re-enablement
features.description: A mechanism to allow sudo commands only for firewall initialization and removal of sudo permissions after execution, with Claude attempting to help modify the init firewall script to re-enable firewall rules.
caveats: Claude declined initial request but was convinced through container approach
Script had some execution issues

features.name: Claude Code container security model
features.description: Claude Code cannot directly escape or perform vulnerable operations when constrained in a sandbox, but can be guided through proper problem framing to help solve issues iteratively.
caveats: Requires careful problem framing to be effective
Cannot bypass security constraints directly
